docs.summary: Reads one container format. Hand an implementation to [`Register`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ImageDecoderRegistry~Register) to add a format or replace a built in decoder. Implementations must not throw for malformed input, and must honour the [`DecodeOptions`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.DecodeOptions) limits before allocating rather than after.
Extensions conventionally used for this format, leading dot included, lowercase. Purely informational; detection is driven by content.

Whether pixel decoding is implemented. When false the decoder still reports header facts through [`TryIdentify`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.IImageDecoder~TryIdentify) and [`TryDecode`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.IImageDecoder~TryDecode) fails with [`NotImplemented`](#api~Prowl.Aperture.ApertureError~NotImplemented).
